CC: routine diabetic foot evaluation
HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Exam: plantar callus area consistent with extensive callus burden with pain on ambulation. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.
MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents. Mentioned other complaints, no separate management plan.
Procedure: Paring of extensive hyperkeratotic lesions performed (LT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
